raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "in-plane cantilever domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Table 3 nor Sec. 5.1 gives Lx and Ly for cantilever_basic. Mesh counts and the dimensions of other examples do not determine its physical dimensions or aspect ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "Lx = 2, Ly = 1",
        "Lx = 3, Ly = 1",
        "Lx = 60, Ly = 30"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness of the 2-D cantilever",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 2-D formulation in Sec. 3.3 does not specify thickness or a per-unit-depth convention. A constant thickness changes compliance scaling for fixed resultant forces.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t = 1",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the chosen length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "element counts assigned to cantilever_basic",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 3 does not explicitly identify this case's mesh. Algorithm 2's default and the matching compliance in Table 5 strongly suggest 60 × 30, but the case-to-mesh mapping is not stated; Sec. 4.1 also lists 120 × 40 standard cantilevers.",
      "readings": [
        "60 × 30 elements, using the default and inferred Table 5 correspondence",
        "120 × 40 elements, using the other listed standard cantilever resolution"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite elements and integration rule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 refers to the earlier solver without specifying the 2-D element interpolation or quadrature. A structured grid alone does not determine these.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2 × 2 Gauss integration",
        "Eight-node serendipity quadrilaterals with 3 × 3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "tip load location on the free right edge",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 maps 'cantilever' to a tip load without specifying its y-coordinate. The mid-right prompt in Sec. 4.1 is an illustrative hole example, not an explicitly identified cantilever_basic prompt.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint: (Lx, Ly/2)",
        "Lower-right corner: (Lx, 0)",
        "Upper-right corner: (Lx, Ly)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial distribution of the tip load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The case's load specification is absent. Algorithm 2 says only 'tip load', while Secs. 3.1–3.2 support both point forces and distributed edge loads.",
      "readings": [
        "One concentrated force assembled at the nearest right-edge node",
        "Uniform traction over the entire right edge, with the same total resultant and trapezoidal nodal weighting"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "cantilever_basic applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force vector is given specifically for this row. Algorithm 2 does not specify direction, and the downward force described in Sec. 4.1 belongs to an illustrative prompt.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse downward force: (Fx, Fy) = (0, -F)",
        "Axial force: (Fx, Fy) = (F, 0)",
        "Diagonal force: (Fx, Fy) = (F/sqrt(2), -F/sqrt(2))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "total applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Table 3 gives no force magnitude. The Fy = -1 example in Sec. 4.1 is not explicitly assigned to cantilever_basic.",
      "readings": [
        "Resultant magnitude F = 1 in consistent force units",
        "Resultant magnitude F = 10 in the same units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "passive mask, particularly support and load attachment cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The passive-region list for this row is not printed. Separate hole and insert cases suggest a plain beam, but the text does not explicitly establish an empty mask or specify whether attachment cells are frozen solid.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive elements; all cells are designable",
        "Freeze the first element column adjacent to the clamp at density 1",
        "Freeze the clamp-adjacent column and cells incident to the loaded node at density 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "target volume fraction for cantilever_basic",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 states a default Vf = 0.5, but the actual prompt and ProblemSpec for this row are absent. Sec. 4.1 lists explicit volume-fraction variants without assigning a value to cantilever_basic.",
      "readings": [
        "Vf = 0.50, applying the configurator default",
        "Vf = 0.40, treating the case as explicitly configured at a listed benchmark fraction",
        "Vf = 0.60, treating the case as explicitly configured at another listed benchmark fraction"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid-material elastic stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 supplies no Young's modulus or equivalent reference stiffness for this example.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized Young's modulus E0 = 1",
        "Young's modulus E0 = 210 GPa with consistent physical units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "elastic constitutive law and stiffness ratios",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper does not give a Poisson ratio or constitutive tensor for cantilever_basic, nor explicitly state isotropy.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic linear elasticity with Poisson ratio 0.30",
        "Isotropic linear elasticity with Poisson ratio 0.25",
        "Orthotropic linear elasticity aligned with the grid: Ex/Ey = 2, Gxy/Ey = 0.4, nu_xy = 0.25 and nu_yx = 0.125"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "2-D elastic idealization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.3 and 4.1 identify a 2-D problem but do not specify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "continuation controller used for the configuration-accuracy example",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 4.4 and Table 3 specify the LLM controller, while the associated Figure 5 caption says both configurations were solved with the schedule controller.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the LLM agent, following the Table 3 protocol",
        "Use the deterministic schedule, following the Figure 5 caption"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial exploration parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says controller initialization returns p, beta, r_min and delta, but gives no starting tuple for this run. The published tail tuple does not determine exploration initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Start with (p, beta, r_min, delta) = (1, 1, 3, 0.20)",
        "Start with (p, beta, r_min, delta) = (3, 1, 1.5, 0.10)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "LLM controller observation interval",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.2 says the LLM observes the solver every k iterations without giving k.",
      "readings": [
        "k = 1",
        "k = 5",
        "k = 10"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "exploration update policy and realized parameter/restart history",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.3 and 4.2 do not provide the controller prompt, state representation, grayness-gate rule or actual sequence of parameter updates and restarts. Model identity, temperature and seed do not specify that sequence; Sec. 6.5 acknowledges API variability.",
      "readings": [
        "Increase p to 3 early; permit beta increases once grayness is at most 0.15; hold r_min = 1.5 and delta = 0.10 during exploration; perform no exploration restarts",
        "Delay p = 3 until mid-exploration; permit beta increases once grayness is at most 0.05; tighten r_min from 3 to 1.5 and delta from 0.20 to 0.05; restart from the best valid snapshot after a twofold compliance spike"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter radius units and distance convention",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 gives the tail radius r_min = 1.20 without defining its units or whether distances use grid indices or physical centroid coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Euclidean distance in element-index coordinates; tail radius 1.20 cells",
        "Euclidean distance between physical centroids; tail radius 1.20 domain-coordinate units"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter weights",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Equation 5 specifies a normalized weighted average within r_min but does not define w_ej.",
      "readings": [
        "Conical weights w_ej = max(0, r_min - d_ej)",
        "Uniform weights w_ej = 1 for d_ej < r_min and zero otherwise",
        "Truncated Gaussian weights exp(-d_ej^2/(2*(r_min/2)^2)) inside r_min"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Heaviside projection definition",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Equation 5 names H_beta but gives neither its formula nor a projection threshold. These are delegated to references whose contents are not supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized tanh projection with fixed threshold eta = 0.50",
        "Normalized tanh projection with fixed threshold eta = 0.30",
        "Exponential projection H_beta(s) = 1 - exp(-beta*s) + s*exp(-beta)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP stiffness interpolation and residual stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 names SIMP interpolation without specifying its precise law or any additive stiffness floor. The stated density lower bound does not determine a separate residual modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "E(rho_tilde) = E0*rho_tilde^p, with no additive stiffness floor",
        "E(rho_tilde) = E0*[10^-9 + (1 - 10^-9)*rho_tilde^p]",
        "E(rho_tilde) = E0*[10^-6 + (1 - 10^-6)*rho_tilde^p]"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Equation 6 specifies uniform initialization only for a tail lacking a valid snapshot. The initial density field for the ordinary exploration solve is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform design density rho_e = Vf",
        "Seed-42 perturbations within Vf ± 0.01, recentered to mean Vf"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimality-criteria update formula",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 specifies OC with a move limit but does not give the multiplicative update or damping exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Multiply density by the square root of the sensitivity-to-multiplier ratio, then apply bounds and move limits",
        "Multiply density by the cube root of that ratio, then apply bounds and move limits"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC multiplier-bisection accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2–3.3 mention OC bisection without specifying its stopping tolerance. The evaluator's volume-fidelity tolerance is a separate post-solve criterion.",
      "readings": [
        "Terminate when relative volume residual is at most 10^-3",
        "Terminate when relative volume residual is at most 10^-8"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "early stopping and convergence window",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The main iteration budget and tail length are given, but Secs. 3.4 and 4.3 also mention early exit, compliance stability and functional convergence without a complete stopping rule or stability-window length.",
      "readings": [
        "Execute all 300 main iterations and all 40 tail iterations",
        "Stop exploration early when relative compliance range is below 0.005 over 10 iterations, then execute the 40-iteration tail",
        "Use the same early-stop threshold over 20 iterations, then execute the 40-iteration tail"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
